design-modules.responsibility: Define the high-level module/bounded-context decomposition for the property management platform, naming the core domains (tenant, contract, billing, workorder, auth, shared/common) and stating each module's responsibility and its dependencies on the others.
design-modules.implementation: Performed as a domain-modeling and decomposition exercise: enumerate candidate subdomains from the platform's capabilities, group cohesive responsibilities into bounded contexts, assign a single owner-responsibility per context, and capture the dependency graph between contexts. The output is typically a module map plus a responsibility/dependency matrix that downstream event, API, and data design steps can reference.
design-modules.design_intent: To establish a shared structural backbone for the platform before any cross-cutting design (events, API contracts, data contracts) is attempted, so that each downstream artifact has a known owning context and a clear direction of dependency, reducing coupling and ambiguous ownership later.
design-modules.constraints: Coverage must include the listed contexts (tenant, contract, billing, workorder, auth, and shared/common capabilities); each context must have a single, non-overlapping responsibility; inter-context dependencies must be made explicit and kept acyclic where possible; common/cross-cutting concerns (e.g., auth) must be treated as a shared kernel rather than duplicated.

doc-ops.responsibility: 该文档为物业管理系统在生产环境的运行维护提供规范,覆盖监控观测、告警分级、灾备方案与应急 Runbook 等运维主题。
doc-ops.implementation: 在文档层面以章节形式组织运维知识,通常包含 Prometheus 指标采集与可视化、告警等级划分与升级机制、备份/恢复策略与定期演练流程、面向 SRE 的标准 Runbook 结构;具体技术选型需依据上层架构决策。
doc-ops.design_intent: 在整体架构设计中把可运维性(observability、reliability、incident response)作为一等公民,确保系统上线后具备可观测、可恢复、可演练的运行保障,而不仅关注功能实现。
doc-ops.constraints: 文档需与部署运维子文档(write-deploy-ops)保持口径一致,告警分级与 SLO 应能追溯到功能模块,灾备方案需可被定期演练验证,Runbook 须对值班人员可执行。

doc-contract.responsibility: Documents the contract module of the property management platform, covering contract lifecycle, terms, performance, change, and termination flows.
doc-contract.implementation: Typically a Markdown file under the docs/ tree that follows the platform's documentation conventions, written alongside other module docs by a module-documentation task and consumed by readers reviewing the contract domain.
doc-contract.design_intent: Provides a single, navigable reference for the contract domain so architects, developers, and stakeholders can understand its scope, boundaries, and processes without reading source code, supporting the broader goal of producing a coherent property management platform architecture.
doc-contract.constraints: Must remain a descriptive artifact rather than executable logic; should align in structure and terminology with sibling module docs produced by the same documentation task; should not duplicate detailed implementation specifics that belong in code or L2 sources.

write-module-docs.responsibility: Produce the eight module-level documentation artifacts (overview, tenants, contracts, billing, work orders, authentication, common capabilities, data model) that collectively describe the property management platform's architectural modules.
write-module-docs.implementation: As a documentation-writing task, it is realized by drafting structured text documents — typically one per module using a consistent template — synthesizing the outputs of upstream design work into a coherent, navigable documentation set, with cross-references between modules and shared terminology aligned to the data-contract vocabulary.
write-module-docs.design_intent: It exists to turn the abstract system design into a stable, human-readable reference that fixes each module's scope and boundaries, bridging upstream design decisions (data contracts) to downstream operational artifacts (deploy/ops), and giving readers a single authoritative picture of how the platform is decomposed.
write-module-docs.constraints: Must cover exactly the eight enumerated modules; must stay consistent with the upstream data-contract design so that downstream deploy/ops documentation can reference it; documentation describes role and responsibility rather than prescribing concrete implementation; the set must be internally coherent and use a shared template so modules are comparable.

start.responsibility: Serves as the entry point of a task flow that produces a property management system platform architecture, with user requirements already clarified and ready to drive the downstream work.
start.implementation: Acts as a lightweight orchestration node that holds the clarified requirements as its input state and hands off to the deliverable-producing phase, without performing any architecture design itself.
start.design_intent: Exists to mark the hand-off from requirements clarification into actual architecture production, ensuring the subsequent deliverable node has a clean, agreed-upon starting brief rather than re-litigating scope.
start.constraints: Requirements are already settled and must not be reopened at this stage; the node contributes no domain content itself and only exists to gate progression to the deliverable.

doc-billing.responsibility: 为物业管理平台的计费域提供领域说明文档，描述账单生成、收费、滞纳金、对账与发票等子能力在该系统中的角色与边界。
doc-billing.implementation: 以 Markdown 形式存放于 docs/ 目录下，按编号（04-billing-context.md）归属于一个模块化文档集合，作为计费上下文文档被 write-module-docs 任务产出。
doc-billing.design_intent: 在整体物业管理系统架构文档体系中，作为计费这一核心业务域的上下文说明，与其它编号模块文档（01、02、03…）共同构成对平台业务边界的完整描述。
doc-billing.constraints: 文档语言与其它模块文档保持一致（中文）；作为上下文级文档，不应混入实现细节，应聚焦职责、边界与协作对象；编号与路径需与整体文档约定一致以便被检索和引用。

design-api-contracts.responsibility: Define and document the cross-module interface contracts—REST APIs and asynchronous event schemas with OpenAPI 3.1 skeletons—for each bounded context in the property management platform architecture.
design-api-contracts.implementation: Typically carried out by authoring one OpenAPI 3.1 specification per bounded context covering REST endpoints, alongside companion event/schema definitions for asynchronous interactions, versioned and stored alongside the architectural artifacts so they can be reviewed and consumed by implementers and integrators.
design-api-contracts.design_intent: To make the implicit boundaries surfaced by the prior module-design step explicit, stable, and reviewable, so that downstream teams can implement, mock, and integrate against a shared source of truth rather than ad-hoc assumptions.
design-api-contracts.constraints: Contracts must respect the bounded context boundaries established upstream; REST and event surfaces together must cover all cross-context interactions; OpenAPI 3.1 conformance is required for the REST skeletons; schemas must remain stable enough to be referenced by other architecture artifacts.

doc-tenant.responsibility: 记录物业管理系统中租户子域（tenant bounded context）的领域边界、对外契约与数据形态，作为整体架构文档中该模块的权威说明。
doc-tenant.implementation: 作为一个 Markdown 文档文件（02-tenant-context.md），按 DDD 风格组织章节——上下文界定、API 契约、领域事件、数据模型，由 write-module-docs 任务统一产出的模块文档序列中的一份。
doc-tenant.design_intent: 在物业平台的多模块架构中，把租户这一核心领域（涉及租赁关系、租约、租金等）作为独立 bounded context 进行显式建模，使上下游模块能基于稳定契约协作，支撑业主、房源、账单、合同等相邻上下文的集成。
doc-tenant.constraints: 内容须与同系列的其他模块文档（如业主、房源、合同等）保持术语与边界一致；租户上下文应与认证/权限/计费等横切关注点保持解耦；只描述角色与契约，不替代代码实现。

deliverable.responsibility: Terminal deliverable of the architecture-design workflow: a complete technical architecture document set (10 Markdown files) describing the structure, capabilities, data model, deployment, and operations of a commercial real-estate property management platform.
deliverable.implementation: Typically realized as a coordinated set of Markdown documents organized by domain concern — an overarching architecture overview plus focused documents on tenants, contracts, billing, work orders, authentication, shared/cross-cutting capabilities, data model, deployment, and operations/maintenance — authored sequentially as the workflow progresses from the start node to this terminal deliverable.
deliverable.design_intent: Exists as the single consolidated artifact that captures the platform's end-to-end architecture in a form stakeholders can read, review, and hand off; it is what the workflow ultimately produces and what downstream engineering or review tasks would consume.
deliverable.constraints: Must cover all ten named documentation areas (architecture overview, tenants, contracts, billing, work orders, authentication, general capabilities, data model, deployment, operations); documents must be mutually consistent in terminology and cross-referenced so they read as one coherent set; delivered in Markdown for portability and review; scoped to commercial (not residential) property management.

design-data-contracts.responsibility: Define the cross-module data contracts for the property management platform, including the core entity ER diagram, the shared kernel, and the eventual consistency boundaries between bounded contexts.
design-data-contracts.implementation: Produces a design artifact that maps core domain entities and their relationships, identifies the subset of data and types shared across modules, and explicitly marks boundaries where consistency must be eventual rather than transactional. The output is consumed by the subsequent module-documentation step and is built on top of the prior module-design step.
design-data-contracts.design_intent: To give the architecture a stable, referenceable data contract so that independently designed modules can interoperate without coupling on internal representations, and so that consistency expectations are made explicit rather than implicit.
design-data-contracts.constraints: Sits between module design (predecessor) and module documentation (successor); must stay at the contract/semantic level and not pre-commit to storage, schema, or persistence choices made by individual modules; must surface eventual consistency boundaries rather than hide them inside modules.

doc-data-model.responsibility: 作为物业管理系统平台架构文档的第 08 章，承载数据模型层的设计说明，描述核心领域实体的 ER 关系、跨限界上下文的共享内核以及最终一致性边界。
doc-data-model.implementation: 以 Markdown 文件形式存在，预期包含实体清单与 ER 图（描述业主、房产、费用、设备、工单等核心实体及其关系）、共享内核子域的标识与归属、以及在分布式或微服务视角下做出最终一致性取舍的边界说明。
doc-data-model.design_intent: 在整体架构文档体系中作为持久化与领域建模视角的承载体，使开发者与架构师能据此统一理解系统状态结构、跨上下文的数据契约，以及在 CAP 取舍下明确哪些交互可以接受最终一致而非强一致。
doc-data-model.constraints: 需与上游限界上下文划分保持一致；共享内核部分需清晰标识哪些实体属于多上下文共享；最终一致性边界应给出明确的滞后容忍与冲突解决约定；不与其他章节的上下文边界描述相矛盾。

doc-workorder.responsibility: Captures the domain scope and business rules for the workorder (工单) module of the property management platform — covering repair requests, dispatch, completion, evaluation and SLA handling — as a reference document for the overall architecture.
doc-workorder.implementation: Realized as a Markdown context file under the architecture docs tree (docs/05-workorder-context.md), expected to describe actors, lifecycle states, cross-module touch points and SLA expectations in prose plus lightweight diagrams or tables.
doc-workorder.design_intent: Serves as the single source of truth that aligns engineers and stakeholders on what the workorder domain must support, so that service boundaries, data models and integrations in the platform architecture can be derived consistently rather than re-invented per component.
doc-workorder.constraints: Must stay domain-focused (not implementation-specific), should enumerate the full workorder lifecycle (报修→派工→完工→评价) and explicit SLA obligations, and must remain consistent with sibling module docs produced by the same write-module-docs effort.

doc-overview.responsibility: 为物业管理系统平台提供架构层面的总览文档，作为读者理解整个系统业务目标、技术选型、模块划分与关键架构决策的入口。
doc-overview.implementation: 以 Markdown 文件形式存在（路径暗示），按总览类文档的典型组织方式覆盖业务目标、技术栈选型理由、模块全景图以及关键架构决策记录等内容，供后续模块文档引用。
doc-overview.design_intent: 作为整个平台架构说明的顶层锚点，让团队成员和后续的模块级文档（由 write-module-docs 等任务产出）拥有一致的整体视角与共享语境，避免模块设计偏离总体架构方向。
doc-overview.constraints: 需保持与各模块文档的一致性；关键架构决策应以可追溯的方式记录而非临时变更；作为总览文档，应专注于全局视角而不陷入模块内部实现细节。

write-deploy-ops.responsibility: Produce two operations-oriented documents for a property management platform: a deployment guide covering orchestration, service discovery, and traffic protection, and an operations guide covering observability, alerting, and disaster recovery.
write-deploy-ops.implementation: Authored as standalone documentation artifacts that aggregate platform-level operational knowledge, drawing on the previously written module docs and feeding the final architecture deliverable; structured around standard ops concerns (environment provisioning, release procedure, runtime protection, monitoring, alerting, failover) without specifying concrete manifests.
write-deploy-ops.design_intent: Closes the gap between design-time architecture and runtime operability so the platform can be reliably deployed, observed, and recovered in production, and ensures the architecture deliverable is grounded in real deployment and operations realities rather than abstract diagrams.
write-deploy-ops.constraints: Must cover both deployment (K8s + Nacos + Sentinel) and operations (monitoring / alerting / disaster recovery) as separate documents; must remain consistent with the module documentation produced upstream and with the final architecture deliverable; must speak at a level that an ops team can act on without inventing unsupported specifics.

doc-deploy.responsibility: Provides deployment documentation covering Kubernetes orchestration, Nacos service registry, Sentinel traffic protection, and CI/CD pipelines for the property management platform.
doc-deploy.implementation: As a Markdown documentation file, it typically describes infrastructure topology, deployment manifests, environment configuration, and operational runbooks at a role-and-purpose level.
doc-deploy.design_intent: Exists to guide operators and developers in reliably deploying and operating the property management platform across environments, ensuring consistency between runtime services and the broader architectural intent.
doc-deploy.constraints: Must remain aligned with the platform's runtime dependencies (Nacos, Sentinel, K8s) and any CI/CD conventions adopted by the project.

doc-common.responsibility: 文档化物业管理平台中横切性的通用能力（通知、文件、消息、缓存、分布式 ID 等），为各业务模块提供共享能力的使用指引与统一约定。
doc-common.implementation: 以 Markdown 文档形式组织，按能力主题分章节说明各横切关注点的定位、典型用法与调用约定，作为团队协作时的参考手册而非运行时实现。
doc-common.design_intent: 在物业管理平台架构中，业务模块众多（房产、业主、缴费、维修、门禁等），需要把跨模块复用的非业务能力沉淀到独立文档，避免在每个模块文档里重复描述，从而支撑一致的横切设计。
doc-common.constraints: 作为通用能力说明文档，内容应保持平台无关、模块无关；只描述能力用途与约定，不绑定具体业务场景；需与各业务模块文档保持解耦，便于单独演进。

doc-auth.responsibility: Defines the authentication, authorization, multi-tenancy isolation, SSO integration, and audit-logging model for the property management platform so that security boundaries are explicit and consistent across modules.
doc-auth.implementation: As a Markdown document under docs/06-auth-context.md, it is expected to enumerate tenant boundaries, role/permission catalogs, SSO entry points, and audit event categories in prose and diagrams rather than executable code; it is consumed by engineers and reviewers rather than by runtime components.
doc-auth.design_intent: The platform operates in a multi-tenant SaaS context where property managers, staff, owners, and external service providers all interact, so a dedicated auth context document is needed to keep identity, tenancy, and compliance concerns decoupled from individual feature modules and to anchor later implementation against a single source of truth.
doc-auth.constraints: Must cover all four pillars implied by the L0 summary (multi-tenancy isolation, RBAC, SSO, audit) in a way that other module docs can reference without duplication; should remain vendor- and mechanism-agnostic at this layer so concrete provider choices are deferred to lower-level design.

design-domain-events.responsibility: 定义物业管理系统中跨模块的业务领域事件集合及其流转关系，确保各子模块通过事件进行解耦协作。
design-domain-events.implementation: 以事件清单的方式枚举关键业务事件（如合同创建、账单生成、工单完成等），并约定每个事件的发布者、订阅者及基本语义，作为后续模块间集成的契约。
design-domain-events.design_intent: 在已划分的模块基础上引入事件驱动视角，使模块之间的副作用传递、数据同步与状态推进显式化，避免模块直接互相调用造成的紧耦合。
design-domain-events.constraints: 事件命名应保持领域语义稳定且全局唯一；事件流转需保证至少一次或最终一致的可靠性；事件不应承担跨模块的核心业务逻辑编排职责，仅作为状态变化的载体。
